author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Semrush One is your one pane of glass across classic SEO rankings and modern AEO metrics, so you can see where your brand shows up in Google and in AI models. 

🛜 Semrush One 14-Day Free Trial ➜ https://semrush.sjv.io/c/3548125/3751310/13053?subid1=youtube&sharedid=https://youtu.be/0dciBGNBOLc 

We focus on metrics first: you’ll set a clear tracking goal by selecting the keywords you care about ranking for. Then we'll show you how Semrush One tracks rankings over time and show you where “#1” still matters versus where AI answers absorb the click. 

You’ll build a realistic keyword shortlist using Keyword Magic Tool and Organic Research, filtering by difficulty and focusing on “close-to-winning” positions, so Semrush One drives early gains rather than vanity tracking. 

Afterward, you’ll assemble 25–50 high-intent prompts and track them in Prompt Tracking to see which sources get cited, where your competitors dominate, and where Semrush One highlights topic and source opportunities.
title: Semrush One - Your New SEO and AEO Dashboard
